verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Slack has a live, documented Web API and Events API (and even an OpenAPI probe attempt that 404s), but nothing in the pack references API versioning, version numbers, or a documented deprecation policy/timeline for retiring old API versions or endpoints. Without such documentation, an AI-native user cannot verify Slack commits to a stable, versioned API lifecycle. Missing for 10: explicit API versioning scheme, changelog/deprecation notices, migration guides, sunset timelines for old endpoints.
